description: Source code implementing JSON template processing functions using the Jansson library, including functions for file, memory, and stream output, as well as template application.

methods.name: start
methods.description: Initializes the exploration context for template processing.

methods.name: compare
methods.description: Compares the current selection with a given value.

methods.name: sel
methods.description: Selects a value from the current context by name.

methods.name: subsel
methods.description: Selects a sub-value from an array or object.

methods.name: enter
methods.description: Enters a new scope for iteration over an object or array.

methods.name: next
methods.description: Moves to the next item in an iteration.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Retrieves the current value as a string.
